# Your changes, and what a rebuild keeps

The suite is rebuilt by Suite Builder when the site changes: every file it wrote is written again. What you write
is kept, in two ways.

## YOURS blocks

Generated files have marked places for your code:

```
// ==== YOURS (extras): safe to edit; regenerating keeps what is between these lines ====
// your code here
// ==== END YOURS (extras) ====
```

Whatever is between those two lines stays, rebuild after rebuild. A change made anywhere else in a generated file
is put back by the next rebuild; the version you had goes into `orphaned/`, so nothing is lost.

## Files of your own

A file Suite Builder did not write is never touched: your own tests, helpers and data. A test of your own goes
beside the generated ones, in a file of its own.

## The suite's rules

The suite checks itself: how tests are written, and that no generated file was edited outside its YOURS blocks
(`SUITE-RULES.md`). `SuiteRulesTest` runs last in a whole run and reports each one. A broken rule says where, why the rule exists, and what to change.
